desc: Restaurant & bar in a rooftop space offering Indian & Asian fare to go with panoramic skyline views.
addr: 13th Floor, Tower-B, 84, Mahatma Gandhi Rd, Haridevpur, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001, India

A suprise restaurant on the 13th floor (sic). It is a covered terrace deck that gives an unrestricted view of famous buildings in Bangalore. …
